finding_groups.problem: Some global inventory and chapter expectations pointed only to example pages. CELEX was not labelled as record-derived metadata.
finding_groups.correction: Add explicit inventories and chapter source locations; distinguish PDF text from source-record metadata.

finding_groups.problem: Original case incorrectly claimed broken quotation glyphs in reference extraction. There are zero U+FFFD characters; the apparent corruption was console display.
finding_groups.correction: Replace with the real U+00AD line-break case and valid Unicode checks. Correct the source normalization policy.

finding_groups.problem: Relationship cases mixed structural facts with one retrieval strategy or one status-name implementation. An inferred recital link was treated as a critical exact edge.
finding_groups.correction: Keep chapter membership exact; make inferred-link recall advisory; allow equivalent external-target states under an explicit source-only setup.

finding_groups.problem: Several expected objects were too abbreviated to catch important omissions or scope errors. Article 6 only listed a-f; the request-deadline case omitted Articles 15-22 scope.
finding_groups.correction: Expand the legal facts and qualifications. State partial test scope. Mark the calculated date as derived rather than extracted. Preserve inclusive OR.

finding_groups.problem: Illustrative search phrases and optional terms were mixed into mandatory expectations. Silence in an Article 28 agreement was not distinguished clearly enough from an operational breach.
finding_groups.correction: Move examples outside scored facts, accept equivalent queries and statuses, and allow a justified contractual gap without claiming observed operational misconduct.

finding_groups.problem: Exact subclause IDs and a mandatory 28(3)(d) route could reject valid passage retrieval. Article 33(1) was unnecessarily mandatory for a processor-only question. Vector null was descriptive, not a scored output.
finding_groups.correction: Match actual source coverage, permit valid direct routes, make comparison context optional, and define isolated retrieval/index preconditions and concrete decoys.

finding_groups.problem: Synthetic scenarios left assumptions implicit and a drafting case could require a legal citation inside the clause itself.
finding_groups.correction: State evidence boundaries and assumptions; permit citation metadata separate from clause prose; preserve controller timing qualifications.

confirmed: 99 article headings, 173 recital headings, 11 chapter headings
Confidentiality alternatives, controller choice and processor breach-notification distinction
limitations: Semantic facts and product rubrics still need independent human approval.
No machine scorer implementation is delivered by this audit.
Full paragraph coverage and all relation types are not certified by 60 cases.
Reference spans remain context windows; raw footnotes and headers inside them are not expected clean rule bodies.
